scope: Private headless Gamescope; CPU engine and GPU submission timelines are not physical display delivery. No strict 144 FPS floor or complete artifact cure established.

cave.scope:
Join completed CPU/GPU logs by frame identity within recorded bench windows.

GPU spans include scheduling inside the timestamp envelope. Submission-to-start
delay includes queued work, semaphore waits and scheduling; it is not a measured
driver-only cost. Neither timeline proves physical display delivery.

runs.label: gpu-span-cave-a

engine_metrics.scope: engine acquire-to-acquire wall interval; not display delivery

runs.gpu_cadence_scope: Adjacent submissions whose corresponding complete CPU intervals both fall inside the window; GPU timestamps, not physical display delivery.

runs.label: gpu-span-cave-b

engine_metrics.scope: engine acquire-to-acquire wall interval; not display delivery

runs.gpu_cadence_scope: Adjacent submissions whose corresponding complete CPU intervals both fall inside the window; GPU timestamps, not physical display delivery.

convergence.note:
Review post-turn convergence, using each shot's own settled image as a reference.

This is a transient-image difference proxy, not an absolute quality score.
Exposure is normalized within each wall crop. Torch, hands and HUD are excluded.
The motion end is estimated from captured frames, not ffmpeg startup time.
